test.title: A toy you liked when you were a child

document.cue: Describe a toy you liked when you were a child.

text: When I was about seven, my favourite toy was a big set of wooden building blocks. They weren't anything special to look at — just cubes, arches and long planks painted in bright colours — but I played with them almost every day for years.

They were a present from my grandfather, who made most of them himself in his workshop. He was a carpenter, and he'd sanded every piece so carefully that there wasn't a single rough edge. I remember he even carved my initials into the lid of the box, which made me feel very grown-up.

Mostly I built cities with them. I'd spend whole afternoons on the living room floor making towers, bridges and roads, and then my little brother would knock everything down, which usually ended in tears. Once, I built a copy of our apartment block, and my parents were so impressed that they took a photo of it.

Looking back, I think I loved those blocks because there were no rules. Unlike a lot of modern toys, they didn't tell me what to do or make noises when I pressed a button, so I had to use my imagination and make up my own stories.
And of course, the fact that my grandfather made them by hand makes them even more special to me now.

tips.en: I'd spend and would knock everything down describe repeated actions in childhood.
tips.kk: I'd spend … would knock everything down — балалықта қайталанған іс-әрекетке would.
tips.ru: I'd spend … would knock everything down — would для того, что повторялось в детстве.
tips.example: I'd spend whole afternoons on the living room floor

tips.en: Unlike a lot of modern toys gives the reason more weight.
tips.kk: Unlike a lot of modern toys — салыстыру себепті салмақты етеді.
tips.ru: Unlike a lot of modern toys — сравнение делает причину весомой.

note.en: What the toy was — a simple description and how long it stayed a favourite.
note.kk: Қандай ойыншық — қарапайым сипаттама және «қанша уақыт ұнатқаны».
note.ru: Что за игрушка — простое описание и «как долго любил».

note.en: Who gave it — a grandfather who was a carpenter, with a detail about the initials on the lid.
note.kk: Кім сыйлады — ағаш шебері ата, қақпақтағы әріптер туралы дерекпен.
note.ru: Кто подарил — дедушка-плотник, с деталью про буквы на крышке.

note.en: How the speaker played — a past habit and one funny scene with the brother.
note.kk: Қалай ойнады — өткендегі әдет және інісімен болған бір күлкілі көрініс.
note.ru: Как играл — привычка в прошлом и одна смешная сцена с братом.

note.en: Why the speaker loved it — through a comparison with modern toys.
note.kk: Неге жақсы көрді — қазіргі ойыншықтармен салыстыру арқылы.
note.ru: Почему любил — через сравнение с современными игрушками.

note.en: The ending returns to the grandfather, so the story comes full circle.
note.kk: Соңы атаға қайта оралады — әңгіме тұйықталады.
note.ru: Концовка возвращает к деду — история закольцована.
